name: minimal
note: Designed, sub-led, effects-only films (no music bed): airy digital ticks, low sub swells for moves, one sub-led hit, the designed sub drop, high-passed key ticks. The light touch, the text touch and the snap are CC0 recordings fitted as code: the designed taps and knock they replace read as synth blips to earshot match (p 0.01-0.27 for their role against synth-blip descriptions). Every take passes the model-free audit. Riser, swell and suck are off.

tick.note: an airy digital tick (32 ms): cursor blinks and counters; the air / glass members click in the audit

tick.crisp.note: a short high ping for precise UI ticks

tock.note: the soft low thump of a touch

hit.note: one sub-led gated hit: a single attack, 0.85 s, the weight below 150 Hz; nothing layered on it

land.note: a low round thump (75 Hz body)

land.light.note: light finger steps on a book, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.38 s, 240 Hz centroid: it sits under sub-led sounds): matches 'a soft finger tap on wood' at z +2.07, p 0.99 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_tap/finger: +0.69, p 0.01), realness 0.95 (0.16)

pop.note: a round pop-in thump, no pitch glide

whoosh.short.note: a darker fast pass (381 Hz centroid) that sits under sub-led sounds

whoosh.long.note: the designed low sub swell into a cut (peak at 0.35 s, almost all energy under 150 Hz)

drop.note: the designed drop that blooms after the cut; set edits.pitch to the film's root (G1-C2)

key.note: a high-passed designed key tick for kinetic type, a new take per keystroke

key.space.note: a softer designed tick for spaces

key.return.note: a double tick marks the line end

click.note: a soft designed UI click (53 ms)

snap.note: a switch flip, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.19 s, one attack): matches 'a toggle switch click' at z +2.24, p 1.00 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_pop_in/knock: +0.61, 0.27), realness 0.97 (0.08)

bell.note: the clean ding on two octaves of an F pentatonic around its own pitch (1822 Hz; A5-G7, 10 notes): sparse designed notes, a rung for every progress step, no ringing bell

text.note: a finger tapping a phone, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.33 s, a quiet low tap, untuned so it never fights a note: a new take per fragment): its top tag is 'a soft UI button tap'; realness 0.89 (pro_tap/finger: 0.16); level +5 dB for its lower loudness at the same peak

off.suck: off by default: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a build onto the reveal
off.riser: off by default; pro_riser/air_gate is the short opt-in, never a shepard riser
off.swell: off by default: the sub swell of whoosh.long already carries the move
